headline: Dana Gas Q3 Profit Rises 50% on Surging Kurdistan Gas Output
summary: UAE-listed Dana Gas posted a 50% year-on-year increase in third-quarter net profit, driven by increased natural gas production at the Khor Mor gasfield in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq.
why: Dana Gas is one of the largest independent natural gas producers in the Middle East.

impacts.name: Dana Gas
impacts.why: Higher natural gas extraction volumes boosted quarterly net income by 50%.
